steps.title: Analyze and Redesign 3D Projection Engine
steps.description: Establish multi-shape solid face models inside Cube3DView to replace simple wireframes with shaded geometric solids.

steps.title: Build Dynamic Face and Vertex Matrix Logic
steps.description: Define coordinate matrices for Cube, Pyramid, and Octahedron solid geometries in Cube3DView.java.

steps.title: Implement Depth-Sorting (Painter's Algorithm)
steps.description: Order 3D rendering sequences dynamically so that back faces are rendered prior to front faces to avoid graphic occlusion issues.

steps.title: Formulate Rotated Space Light Source & Shading Vectors
steps.description: Compute face normals using mathematical cross-product matrices in rotCoords, and derive realistic lighting gradients using dot product calculations.

steps.title: Add Interactive Active Shape Switch Controls
steps.description: Revise activity_main.xml layout to incorporate stylish layout tabs allowing immediate switching between Cube, Pyramid, and Octahedron shapes.

steps.title: Integrate Dynamic Card Tilt & Parallax Physics Engine
steps.description: Integrate real-time OnTouchListener inside MainActivity.java mapping touch offsets directly into translationX/Y and rotationX/Y coordinates on cardContainer.

steps.title: Link Shape Buttons with Synthesizer and Active States
steps.description: Connect shape selector triggers to custom UI state styling, audio confirmations, and model invalidations in MainActivity.java.

steps.title: Validate Java 8 Compatibility and Build
steps.description: Execute sanity check sweeps confirming zero Java 9 dependencies are used and verify proper manifest layout namespaces.

steps.title: Building Hello App
steps.description: Compile, build and assemble Hello App using Gradle commands.
